install.note: MiMo CLI is EchoBird's display name for MiMo Code, Xiaomi's CLI coding agent forked from OpenCode. It is separate from MiMo Desktop (MiMo 桌面端 / Xiaomi MiMo); desktop requests use the mimodesktop install reference. The binary is `mimo` (curl installs to ~/.mimocode/bin and updates PATH; restart the shell or source the rc file before verifying). Windows: use the official PowerShell installer or npm. Both official scripts download binaries from Xiaomi FDS, not GitHub Releases. For npm, use the official registry because mirror registries may lag behind platform package releases. Do NOT install OpenCode's `@opencode/cli` — MiMo Code is a separate product with its own npm package `@mimo-ai/cli`.

first_run.description: Launch `mimo` in the project directory. Onboarding offers Xiaomi MiMo Platform browser OAuth login; /connect inside the TUI connects additional providers. Custom Provider accepts an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and API key, and provider definitions can also be added in the config file.
